title: GenomeChronicler-nf pipeline parameters
description: DSL2 Nextflow pipeline for running PGP-UK GenomeChronicler personal genome reports.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet with sample, bam, vcf, and vep columns.
input.help_text: Each row must have either a bam or vcf column filled (not both). The vep column is optional. Paths can be absolute or relative to the launch directory.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.

genomechronicler_options.title: GenomeChronicler options
genomechronicler_options.description: Options passed to the GenomeChronicler container.

threads.description: Number of threads for GATK genotyping steps.

no_clean_temp.description: Keep intermediate temporary files after completion.

gc_container.help_text: Override to use a specific version tag (e.g. ghcr.io/pgp-uk/genomechronicler:v0.0.3) or a local SIF file path.

resource_limits.title: Resource limits
resource_limits.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
